These files are a small vendored subset of the TOSCA high-resolution ASCII mesh
archive used in classic non-rigid shape-correspondence work.

Included shapes:
- `cat0`
- `cat1`
- `cat2`
- `cat6`
- `cat10`

Formats:
- `.vert`: vertex coordinates
- `.tri`: triangle indices
- `.png`: dataset thumbnails

Recovered source archive:
- `https://web.archive.org/web/20240124102714if_/https://tosca.cs.technion.ac.il/data/toscahires-asci.zip`

These assets are bundled for package examples and documentation so the real
shape vignette can render without depending on a live external host.
